name: WAJIB: UBAH KONFIGURASI, PERIKSA MQTT BROKER, LALU DEPLOY FULL
info: Samakan id_group dan node_id dengan python/config.json dan esp32/include/app_config.h. Login default admin / admin123. Broker MQTT berada pada config node MQTT Face Recognition.

name: KONFIGURASI FACE SECURITY — UBAH DI SINI
Validasi group / node / topik
func: const c=global.get('faceConfig');if(!c)return null;const b=c.id_group+'/'+c.node_id+'/';let p=msg.payload;try{if(typeof p==='string')p=JSON.parse(p)}catch(e){node.warn('JSON MQTT tidak valid');return null}if(p.id_group&&p.id_group!==c.id_group)return null;if(p.node_id&&p.node_id!==c.node_id)return null;msg.payload=p;if(msg.topic===b+'face/status')return[msg,null,null,null];if(msg.topic===b+'face/register')return[null,msg,null,null];if(msg.topic===b+'esp32/status')return[null,null,msg,null];if(msg.topic===b+'camera/status')return[null,null,null,msg];return null;

name: Face status → SQL
Pending face_id
func: const p=msg.payload||{};if(p.face_id)flow.set('pendingFace',{face_id:p.face_id,confidence:p.confidence||0,received_at:Date.now()});msg.op='refresh';msg.topic='SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY nama COLLATE NOCASE';return msg;

name: Minta snapshot SQLite
func: msg.op='refresh';msg.topic='SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY nama COLLATE NOCASE';msg.payload=[];delete msg.params;return msg;
